evidence: Contract-agreement review only. All task-relative citations below refer to the frozen .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/task. Workbook Quality Checks row 24 (#23) and skill quality-checks.md:100-102 require matching launch assumptions to public instructions; the internal same-origin annotation is superseded by the current public-network profile. (1) tests/test.sh:48,68,97-111 launches node with entry /app/server.js, PORT=3000 and DB_PATH=/app/app.db; instruction.md:9 explicitly requires each, GET /api/health, a single UI/API process, and honoring PORT/DB_PATH. integration.md:3-10 supplies Node 22, Express/better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH, 0.0.0.0 and health before blocking database work. (2) tests/test.sh:72-83 restricts symlinks to /app/node_modules with targets inside that tree; integration.md:16-19 states the identical boundary and global-package NODE_PATH use. (3) test.sh:90-111 permits an unprivileged writable copy with env -i carrying PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT and DB_PATH, without changing cwd to /app. hireops_rules.md:415-420 explicitly discloses all five variables, non-application cwd, unprivileged execution and a writable application copy; it requires module-relative/absolute bundled paths and honoring DB_PATH. The restart at test.sh:160-189 reuses the same entry and database instead of introducing a new contract. (4) instruction.md:11 explicitly requires copying necessary assets into /app, no runtime /assets or /instructions dependency, no shipped database, one-time seed and durable restarts. No private runtime seed roster is introduced by test.sh. instruction.md:9 and integration.md:3-4 permit only Node built-ins, Express and better-sqlite3; environment/Dockerfile:1-12 and tests/Dockerfile:1-22 supply the same Node family and exact package versions. tests/test.sh, both Dockerfiles and restart_mcp.py match the frozen template byte-for-byte. Public CDN use remains permitted; no same-origin launch demand appears. Conforming alternative considered: a different layout under /app, an initially empty operational desk, module-relative assets, ordinary health response and CDN browser assets satisfies this launcher; it is not required to reproduce golden API routes or import optional operational seed rows. Broken alternative considered: a health-only/static app can meet the deliberately weak liveness probe, but this is not a grading pass: render/judge.toml:23 excludes a health-only/static workspace, and constraints/judge.toml:23-25 demands actual UI creation and independent-context readback. The raw local gate witness records the no-op-create variant failing those observations (results.json:27-34); it is a scripted observation, not a judge score. Every frozen task/rule manifest hash also matched. The runtime probe driver SHA256 ea09e3eaf41b40315912c6f8e3a945bf0fb6704b10de68329ce5e5c7cb522e51 and results SHA256 9faead26c929f712ae554af536c6ddbf10c000921aef59c8bd75b091be901125 matched the index; all 14 recorded solution hashes match this candidate.
